section_path: Chapter 2: Desalter operation > 2.1 NORMAL OPERATING CONDITIONS
text:
### 2.1 NORMAL OPERATING CONDITIONS

The desalter 11-V-02 is operated at 8.5 kg/cm2 g and a desalting temperature of 130 degC. Wash water is injected upstream of the vortex mixer 11-X-01 at normally 6 % on crude. Pressure is held by 11-PIC-1105 to keep the crude in the liquid phase across the vessel; vaporisation inside the desalter disrupts the electrostatic field and carries salt forward into the heater.

### 2.2 VESSEL DATA

Design pressure 15.5 kg/cm2 g. Design temperature 165 degC. The vessel carries two electrode grids energised through a transformer rated at 22 kVA.

### 4.2 POOR DESALTING

If salt carry-over rises, check the wash water rate, the mixing valve pressure drop across 11-X-01, the interface level, and the demulsifier dosing rate. A low desalting temperature is the most common documented cause.
